tools.name: company_list
tools.title: Companies
tools.description: A customer or prospect company. Lists companies with filters, sort and paging (pass `cursor` from the previous result's `next`). A record of another app appears as { uri, kind }: the app the URI names opens it with its fetch tool. Kind: organization.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Searches Companies, Contacts, Deals by text. Returns ids (URIs) to pass to fetch. `kind` limits it to records of one kind; each result says its kind.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch
tools.description: One record by its id (a URI from search or a list), with all fields the caller may see.

tools.name: modelapp_embed
tools.title: Embed ticket
tools.description: For hosts and the app's views: a one-minute, single-use ticket that signs the viewer in to one of the app's embedded pages, framed by a document of the given origin.

page.description: The page's name (manifest pages with a same-site url)

origin.description: The origin of the document that frames the page and posts the ticket

tools.name: modelapp_resolve
tools.title: Resolve
tools.description: For hosts: fragment and record URIs resolved for the viewer.

tools.name: deal_mark_won
tools.title: Mark as won
tools.description: Closes the deal as won. Only when the person says so (a change; the person confirms it first). On one deal: its `id`, and its title in `record_title`.

id.description: The deal's id, from a list, search or get result. When you describe this action or ask the person to approve it, name the deal by its title, never by this id

record_title.description: The deal's title as the list, search or get result gave it, so the person sees which deal they approve. Display only: the app names the deal from its id, and refuses the call if this names another one

tools.name: deal_set_stage
tools.title: Move to stage
tools.description: Moves an open deal to another open stage, or to lost (a change). On one deal: its `id`, and its title in `record_title`.

id.description: The deal's id, from a list, search or get result. When you describe this action or ask the person to approve it, name the deal by its title, never by this id

record_title.description: The deal's title as the list, search or get result gave it, so the person sees which deal they approve. Display only: the app names the deal from its id, and refuses the call if this names another one

tools.name: contact_log_call
tools.title: Log a call
tools.description: Records that we called this contact today, with a note (a change; the person confirms it first). On one contact: its `id`, and its title in `record_title`.

id.description: The contact's id, from a list, search or get result. When you describe this action or ask the person to approve it, name the contact by its title, never by this id

record_title.description: The contact's title as the list, search or get result gave it, so the person sees which contact they approve. Display only: the app names the contact from its id, and refuses the call if this names another one

tools.name: company_link_erp_customer
tools.title: Link to the ERP customer
tools.description: Records which customer of another app (the ERP) this company is (a change). On one company: its `id`, and its title in `record_title`. An input that takes a record of another app takes its URI (modelapp://<app>/<entity>/<id>), as that app's search or lists give it.

id.description: The company's id, from a list, search or get result. When you describe this action or ask the person to approve it, name the company by its title, never by this id

record_title.description: The company's title as the list, search or get result gave it, so the person sees which company they approve. Display only: the app names the company from its id, and refuses the call if this names another one

description.en: Finds deals, prepares follow-ups, moves deals between stages
description.it: Trova trattative, prepara i richiami, sposta le trattative di fase

agents.instructions: You help a sales team. Find deals and contacts with search and the list tools; never guess amounts, read them. Propose a stage change or a won deal only when the person asks, and let them confirm. Suggest calling contacts not called in the last follow_up_days days.
